rounds.text: The underlying fundamentals reflect notable recent acceleration, highlighted by a compounded profit growth of 389% over the trailing twelve months and a 5-year compounded sales and profit growth of 16% [E19, E21]. Operational efficiency is scaling up effectively, evidenced by a massive cash conversion of 3.25x against reported profit, generating Rs 26 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 37 Cr in free cash flow for Mar 2026 [E34, E35, E36]. Furthermore, capital expenditure cycles are bearing fruit as capital work-in-progress (CWIP) dropped by 54.5% to Rs 5 Cr, indicating that new capacity has largely completed and is coming online, while total borrowings simultaneously decreased from Rs 116 Cr to Rs 100 Cr [E39, E40]. Institutional backing remains firm with positive money flow and increased foreign institutional holdings from 3.83% to 4.06% [E42, E44]. Conceded: the stock trades at a rich P/E of 104 and a P/B of 6.88x, while showing a 10-year median return on equity of -30% [E1, E2, E26].

The valuation disconnect is extreme, highlighted by a towering P/E of 104x and a price-to-book ratio of 6.88x against a book value of just ₹ 19.9 [E1, E2]. Fundamental returns fail to justify these multiples, with a 3-year median return on equity of only 6% and a recent ROE of 1.7% that severely trails the sector benchmark of 9.61% [E9, E28]. Profit generation is volatile and cooling, demonstrated by a 3-year compounded profit growth of -28% and explicit flags for decelerating earnings alongside a net profit drop of -109% YoY [E20, E70, E71]. Operating margins are contracting both annually and quarterly, with the Mar 2026 quarterly margin sliding to 4% from 9% a year earlier [E30, E31]. Furthermore, solvency and balance sheet risks loom large, driven by a low interest coverage ratio, high borrowing costs, and a precarious 75.3% promoter pledge on their holdings [E61, E63, E64]. Conceded: [E35], [E36], [E40].
